The path defines four points: (22.06,65.18), (22.58,64.52), (7.52,52.61), (7.00,53.26), and returns to the first point.  
Four distinct points connected sequentially form a quadrilateral.  
Checking side lengths:  
- Between (22.06,65.18) and (22.58,64.52): short vertical/horizontal difference → short side.  
- Between (22.58,64.52) and (7.52,52.61): long diagonal side.  
- Between (7.52,52.61) and (7.00,53.26): short side.  
- Between (7.00,53.26) and (22.06,65.18): long diagonal side.  

Two pairs of adjacent equal sides?  
First pair: distances ≈ 0.72 and ≈ 0.72 (first and third segments) — equal short sides.  
Second pair: distances ≈ 18.22 and ≈ 18.22 (second and fourth segments) — equal long sides.  
Thus, adjacent sides equal in pairs → kite.  

Final answer: (D)
